description: Telangana signs MoU for World Trade Centre at AI City
body_lead: Telangana government has signed an MoU with the World Trade Centres’ Association for the establishment of a World Trade Centre in the proposed AI City near Hyderabad. The WTC at AI City will feature 1 million square feet of built-up space to house firms at the forefront of AI and emerging technologies. “This is poised to be one of the largest capacity building initiatives in the field of Global AI domain,” a release from the IT and Industries Minister D. Sridhar Babu’s office said on Friday.
